integrity: The proof uses a fully specified integral cubical chain complex and exact integer Smith forms; computations are reproducible by the included Python 3/SymPy verifier. No third-party certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite nine-vertex graph calculation. No claim for other rook graphs or for the full braid group; possible unindexed equivalent integral torus-index calculation.
title: An index-four torus-lattice obstruction for two particles on the nine-vertex rook graph
